show.description: Do shehri ladke ek shrapit gaon pahunchte hi ek khubsurat, ajeeb si ladki ke jaal mein phas jaate hain, jo shayad Tilottama ho… woh apsara jiska husn nashe ki tarah chadh kar jaan le leta hai.
